title: COBBLERUNE
description: A Cobblemon modpack that adds many fantasy elements and Cobblemon addons for a better experience (discontinued)
body:
I noticed a lot of modpacks related to Cobblemon mess with the sandbox element of both the mod and Minecraft, and that is what I want here.

The modpack has a lot of mods and addons related to Cobblemon to try and get the best Cobblemon experience. Radical trainers is not inlcuded because of endless grinding, instead you have fierce competition for a more casual experience. It also has Mega Showdown, Fight or Flight, Pokenav, and lesser known addons such as Battlecam, and perfect partners. I have made it so you don't have too mess with the files for datapacks.

There's also new dimensions such as the Aether and Deeper and Darker. There are datapacks to increase compatability.

I also added mics and quality of life mods and resourse packs such as hold my items, Xareos minimap, way stones, artifacts, enchantment infuser, and travellers backpack.

I plan on adding other mods once they're fabric versions are avalible to use.
